title: STS2 AI Agent
changeNote: v0.12.5: two fixes an AI agent runs into, both found by driving a real game. When a run ends, the state now says GAME_OVER instead of still reporting COMBAT - an agent following the documented screen names was waiting for one it could never see, and had to work the end of a run out from the action list. And when a game action fails, the error now names the reason the game gave instead of a single blank sentence shared by eleven different actions, so "the game refused that" no longer reads the same as "the mod broke". Nothing changes for a run that is going well: this version adds no cards, no numbers, and touches no save.
